description: Get detailed information about a specific rental vehicle option. Use this after search_vehicles to get extras, insurance options, charges, and cancellation policy for the vehicle the user wants to book.

acriss_code.description: ACRISS vehicle class code of the chosen car from the search_vehicles result (four letters, e.g. "ICAR"). Pass it through so the right class is priced when a vendor offers several under one rate code.

desk_kind.description: Desk type of the chosen car's pickup desk, from the search_vehicles result. Pass it through whenever the result shows a Desk value.

pickup_location.description: Pickup location of the chosen car from the search_vehicles result. Pass it through when the search covered a whole city, where one vendor can have several desks.

rate_code.description: Rate code of the chosen car from the search_vehicles result. It identifies the priced offer, so copy it exactly.

search_id.description: Search ID returned by the search_vehicles call that listed the chosen car. It ties this lookup to that search's dates and locations.

vendor_code.description: Vendor code from search results (e.g. "ZE" for Hertz, "AL" for Alamo).

vendor_location_id.description: The vendor's identifier for the chosen car's pickup desk, from the search_vehicles result. Pass it through when the result includes one, so the same desk is priced.

name: get_vehicle_details
